vulnerabilities.source: request.get_json() - username and password from user-controlled HTTP request body
evidence: Line 68: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{username}' AND password = '{password}'"
vulnerabilities.description: 用户输入的 username 和 password 直接通过 f-string 拼接进 SQL 查询语句，未使用参数化查询。攻击者可以通过构造恶意输入实现 SQL 注入，绕过认证或窃取数据。

vulnerabilities.source: request.headers.get("X-JWT-Alg") - algorithm from user-controlled HTTP header
vulnerabilities.sink: jwt.encode(token_payload, secret_key, algorithm=algorithm) - JWT signing with attacker-chosen algorithm
vulnerabilities.description: JWT 签名算法从用户可控的 HTTP 请求头 X-JWT-Alg 中读取，未做白名单校验。攻击者可指定 'none' 算法绕过签名验证，或切换为非对称算法利用公钥伪造令牌。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: IDOR - Missing Ownership Verification in User Profile Access
vulnerabilities.source: URL path parameter <int:user_id> - attacker can change user_id to any value
vulnerabilities.sink: user_manager.get_user_by_id(user_id) - fetches user data without ownership check
vulnerabilities.description: 获取用户资料的接口仅验证了用户是否登录（有 token），但未验证所请求的 user_id 是否属于当前登录用户。任何已认证用户可通过遍历 user_id 获取全站用户的敏感信息（包括 SSN、银行账户）。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: SQL Injection in Transactions Listing Endpoint
vulnerabilities.source: Multiple user-controlled query parameters: user_id, limit, offset, sort_by, order
evidence: Line 160: query = f"SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE user_id = {user_id} ORDER BY {sort_by} {order} LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset}"
vulnerabilities.description: 交易列表接口中，user_id、limit、offset、sort_by、order 五个参数均直接拼接进 SQL 查询语句，未做任何参数化处理或白名单校验。攻击者可利用任意参数实施 SQL 注入攻击。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: SSRF in Webhook Handler (XML and JSON paths)
vulnerabilities.source: request body (XML/JSON) - callback_url from user-controlled input
vulnerabilities.sink: requests.post(callback_url, ...) - server-side HTTP request to attacker-controlled URL
evidence: Line 221: response = requests.post(callback_url, json={"result": "processed", "data": payload}, timeout=10)
Line 234-239: response = requests.post(callback_url, json=..., headers=headers, timeout=15, verify=False)
vulnerabilities.description: Webhook 处理接口从用户提交的 XML 或 JSON 数据中提取 callback_url，直接用于服务端 HTTP 请求。未对目标 URL 进行白名单校验，且 verify=False 禁用了 TLS 证书验证。攻击者可利用此漏洞扫描内网、访问云元数据服务。

vulnerabilities.sink: send_file(full_path) - serves file without path sanitization
vulnerabilities.description: 文件下载接口直接将用户输入的 filename 参数与基础路径拼接，未对 '../' 等路径遍历字符进行过滤。攻击者可通过构造类似 '../../../etc/passwd' 的路径读取任意系统文件。

vulnerabilities.source: request.files["file"] - user-uploaded file with original filename
vulnerabilities.sink: uploaded_file.save(save_path) - saves file with original name without validation
vulnerabilities.description: 文件上传接口直接使用用户提供的原始文件名保存文件，未对文件扩展名、MIME 类型或文件内容进行任何校验。攻击者可上传 .py、.php 等可执行脚本文件，结合下载接口的路径遍历可导致远程代码执行。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: OS Command Injection in Admin Backup Endpoint
vulnerabilities.sink: subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, ...) - shell command execution with user input
evidence: Line 317: result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
vulnerabilities.description: 管理员备份接口中，output_path、database、log_pattern 等多个参数直接拼接进 shell 命令字符串，并使用 shell=True 执行。攻击者可通过注入分号、反引号等 shell 元字符实现任意命令执行。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: Hardcoded Credentials Exposed via Config Export
vulnerabilities.source: No authentication required - /api/v1/admin/config/export endpoint has no access control
vulnerabilities.sink: Returns all sensitive credentials in plaintext JSON response
vulnerabilities.description: 配置导出接口没有任何身份验证或授权检查，任何访问者均可调用。接口返回了数据库密码、API密钥、加密密钥、JWT密钥、Stripe/PayPal密钥等全部敏感凭据的明文。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: Insecure Deserialization via Pickle in Config Import
vulnerabilities.source: request.get_json() - config_data from user-controlled request body, base64 decoded
vulnerabilities.description: 配置导入接口接收用户提供的 base64 编码数据，使用 pickle.loads() 进行反序列化。Pickle 反序列化不可信数据可导致任意代码执行，攻击者可构造恶意 pickle payload 实现远程代码执行。

vulnerabilities.source: request.get_json() - template string from user-controlled request body
vulnerabilities.sink: render_user_template(template_string, context) -> env.from_string(template_string).render() - Jinja2 template rendering of user input
evidence: utils/template_engine.py Line 33-37: env = Environment(); template = env.from_string(template_string); rendered_output = template.render(**context)
vulnerabilities.description: 模板渲染接口将用户输入的 template 字符串直接作为 Jinja2 模板进行编译和渲染。攻击者可通过注入 Jinja2 模板表达式（如 {{ config }}、{{ ''.__class__.__mro__ }}）实现服务器端模板注入，进而执行任意代码。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search Endpoint
vulnerabilities.sink: Direct HTML string interpolation without encoding - f-string returns HTML to browser
vulnerabilities.description: 搜索接口将用户输入的 q 参数直接通过 f-string 插入到 HTML 响应中，未进行任何 HTML 实体编码。攻击者可注入任意 JavaScript 代码，实现反射型 XSS 攻击。

vulnerabilities.sink: redirect(next_url) - Flask redirect without URL validation
vulnerabilities.description: 重定向接口直接将用户输入的 next 参数作为重定向目标，未对目标域名进行白名单校验。攻击者可利用此漏洞将用户重定向到恶意网站，用于钓鱼攻击。

vulnerabilities.sink: requests.get(target_url, timeout=10, verify=False) - server-side HTTP request
vulnerabilities.description: 内部代理接口允许用户通过 url 参数指定任意目标 URL，服务端直接发起 HTTP GET 请求。未对目标进行白名单校验，且 verify=False 禁用了 TLS 验证。攻击者可扫描内网、访问云元数据或攻击内部服务。

vulnerabilities.source: CSRF validation always returns True - no actual protection
vulnerabilities.sink: All POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints lack real CSRF protection
evidence: Line 16-19: def validate_csrf_token(token: str) -> bool: return True
Line 35: if not validate_csrf_token(csrf_token): pass  # No action taken even if validation fails
Line 68-81: CSRFManager.validate() - accepts any token longer than 10 chars
vulnerabilities.description: CSRF 防护中间件的 validate_csrf_token 函数始终返回 True，且即使校验失败也仅执行 pass（无操作）。CSRFManager.validate() 方法中，只要 token 长度大于 10 即视为有效。所有修改状态的接口均无有效的 CSRF 防护。

vulnerabilities.sink: All origins allowed to make authenticated cross-origin requests
vulnerabilities.description: CORS 配置中同时设置了 Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * 和 Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true，这是不安全的组合。任何外部网站均可发起携带用户凭据的跨域请求，配合 CSRF 漏洞可导致严重的数据泄露。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: Weak Hashing Algorithm - MD5 Used for Sensitive Data
vulnerabilities.source: Credit card data (number, cvv, expiry) concatenated and hashed with MD5
vulnerabilities.description: 支付处理器使用已破解的 MD5 算法对信用卡号、CVV 和有效期进行哈希处理。MD5 易受碰撞攻击，且未加盐，彩虹表可快速逆向。同时，敏感支付数据在日志中明文记录（Line 32: "card_data": card_data or {}）。

vulnerabilities.vuln_name: Weak Hashing - SHA-256 Without Salt for Passwords
vulnerabilities.source: User password hashed with single SHA-256 without salt
vulnerabilities.description: 用户密码仅使用单次 SHA-256 哈希，未加盐。这使得密码哈希值易受彩虹表攻击和暴力破解。安全的做法应使用 bcrypt、scrypt 或 PBKDF2 等专用密码哈希算法。

vulnerabilities.source: jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False}) - signature verification explicitly disabled
vulnerabilities.sink: All endpoints using get_current_user() accept unsigned/forged tokens
vulnerabilities.description: get_current_user() 函数在解码 JWT 令牌时显式禁用了签名验证（verify_signature: False）。攻击者可伪造任意 JWT 令牌，以任何用户身份（包括 admin）访问系统。
